expression.name: filter.work.deleteByMark
expression.script: DELETE FROM FRM_FILTER WHERE ID IN (SELECT IDROW FROM mrk_ID WHERE IDMARKER = :markerId)

expression.name: filter.group.save
expression.script: INSERT INTO FRM_FILTER_GROUP VALUES (:ID, :CNAME)

expression.name: filter.group.update
expression.script: UPDATE FRM_FILTER_GROUP SET CNAME = :CNAME, ID = :ID WHERE ID = :OLD_ID

expression.name: filter.group.delete
expression.script: DELETE FROM FRM_FILTER_GROUP g WHERE g.ID = :ID

expression.name: filter.work.setPreference
expression.script: {CALL jf_pkg_util.set_prefupper(:KEY,:VALUE)}

expression.name: filter.work.saveFilter
expression.script: begin INSERT INTO FRM_FILTER (cFormName, cUser, cWhereName, cWhereBlk, cAutoSetup, cBlockName) VALUES (:FORM_NAME, :USER, :WHERE_NAME, :WHERE_BLK, :AUTO_SETUP, :BLOCK_NAME) RETURNING ID INTO :IFF_INSERT; end;

expression.name: filter.work.addGroupLink
expression.script: INSERT INTO V_JF_FRM_FILTER_LINK VALUES (:GROUP_ID,:FILTER_ID)

expression.name: filter.work.delGroupLink
expression.script: DELETE FROM V_JF_FRM_FILTER_LINK WHERE idgroup = :GROUP_ID AND idfilter = :FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.addAllGroupLink
expression.script: INSERT INTO V_JF_FRM_FILTER_LINK SELECT idgroup, idfilter FROM (SELECT V_JF_Frm_Filter.id idfilter, V_JF_Frm_Filter_Group.id idgroup, V_JF_Frm_Filter_Group.cname grp_name FROM V_JF_Frm_Filter, V_JF_Frm_Filter_Group WHERE NOT exists (SELECT NULL FROM V_JF_Frm_Filter_Link WHERE V_JF_Frm_Filter_Link.idfilter = V_JF_Frm_Filter.id AND V_JF_Frm_Filter_Link.idgroup = V_JF_Frm_Filter_Group.id)) WHERE idfilter = :FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.delAllGroupLink
expression.script: DELETE FROM V_JF_FRM_FILTER_LINK WHERE idfilter=:FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.addODBGrp
expression.script: INSERT INTO V_JF_FRM_FILTER_ODB_GROUP VALUES (:GROUP_ID,:FILTER_ID)

expression.name: filter.work.delODBGrp
expression.script: DELETE FROM V_JF_FRM_FILTER_ODB_GROUP a WHERE a.idgroup = :GROUP_ID AND a.idfilter = :FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.addAllODBGrp
expression.script: INSERT INTO V_JF_FRM_FILTER_ODB_GROUP SELECT idgroup,idfilter FROM ( SELECT V_JF_Frm_Filter.id idfilter, ODB_Group_USR.grp_id idgroup, ODB_Group_USR.grp_name grp_name FROM V_JF_Frm_Filter, ODB_Group_USR WHERE NOT exists (SELECT NULL FROM V_JF_Frm_Filter_ODB_Group WHERE V_JF_Frm_Filter_ODB_Group.idfilter=V_JF_Frm_Filter.id AND V_JF_Frm_Filter_ODB_Group.idgroup=ODB_Group_USR.grp_id) ) WHERE idfilter=:FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.delAllODBGrp
expression.script: DELETE FROM V_JF_FRM_FILTER_ODB_GROUP WHERE idfilter=:FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.editFilter
expression.script: UPDATE V_JF_FRM_FILTER SET cformname = :FORM_NAME, cuser = :USER, cwhereblk = :WHERE_BLK, cwherename = :WHERE_NAME, cblockname = :BLOCK_NAME WHERE id = :ID

expression.name: filter.work.delFilter
expression.script: DELETE FROM V_JF_FRM_FILTER WHERE ID = :FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.autoSetupFlt
expression.script: UPDATE V_JF_FRM_FILTER SET cautosetup = :AUTO_SETUP WHERE id = :FILTER_ID

expression.name: filter.work.cleanAutoSetupFlt
expression.script: UPDATE V_JF_FRM_FILTER SET CAUTOSETUP = NULL WHERE CAUTOSETUP IS NOT NULL AND CAUTOSETUP = :AUTO_SETUP

expression.name: filter.work.copyFilter
expression.script: {CALL JF_PKG_UTIL.FF_COPY(:FILTER_ID,:USER)}

expression.name: filter.work.getPreference
expression.script: call jf_pkg_util.get_prefUpper(:UPPER_PREF, :DEF_VALUE, :_return)

expression.name: filter.work.getPreference
expression.script: begin :_return := jf_pkg_util.get_prefUpper(:UPPER_PREF, :DEF_VALUE); end;

expression.name: filter.work.cleanAllBuffer
expression.script: {CALL IE_Export.Clear_All()}
